title: Rype's Auto Grindstoner
description: A client-side utility that adds an Auto Grindstone button to the Grindstone GUI, allowing automatic processing of diamond tools and armor from the main inventory.
body:
# Auto Grindstone

Auto Grindstone adds a simple button to the Grindstone screen that automatically disenchantments and grinds all diamond tools and armor in your main inventory.

When the button is pressed, the mod processes items using normal inventory clicks, just like a player would. It does not interact with items in your hotbar and only scans the 27 slots of your main inventory.

### Features

* Automatically grinds all diamond tools and armor found in your main inventory
* Uses regular inventory clicks instead of packet manipulation
* Adjustable processing speed through Mod Menu integration
* Starts with a single button press
* Automatically stops when all valid items have been processed
* Automatically stops when the Grindstone screen is closed
* Simple and lightweight implementation
* Client-side only

### How It Works

1. Open a Grindstone.
2. Press the Auto Grindstone button.
3. The mod will move each eligible diamond item into the Grindstone, remove its enchantments, and continue until every valid item in your main inventory has been processed.
4. Once finished, the automation stops automatically.

### Configuration

The processing speed can be customized through Mod Menu, allowing you to balance speed and compatibility based on the server you are playing on.

### Notes

* Only diamond tools and diamond armor are processed.
* The hotbar is ignored.
* Only the 27 main inventory slots are checked.
* Requires Fabric.
* Recommended alongside Mod Menu for configuration access.
  
### Versions
1.21.11 Only for now, Maybe More Will be added later.

### Example Of Use

Can be used to grindstone 27 of, For example: Shulker (27 items) of diamond helmets bought from armour villagers, to make gsets in bulk.
